analysis_scope: mixed-audio timing and energy measurements only; no isolated-vocal or lyric listening verification

ffmpeg_stream_summary: Stream #0:0[0x2](und): Audio: aac (LC) (mp4a / 0x6134706D), 48000 Hz, stereo, fltp, 162 kb/s (default)
Stream #0:0(und): Audio: pcm_f32le ([3][0][0][0] / 0x0003), 44100 Hz, stereo, flt, 2822 kb/s (default)

decoded_pcm.format: IEEE float32 WAV, resampled to 44100 Hz for analysis; AAC overshoots preserved without integer PCM clipping
decoded_pcm.mono_method: arithmetic mean of decoded left and right channels

reference.reference_precision: normalized 60 Hz envelopes rounded to 0.001; source waveform unavailable

envelope_method.window: periodic Hann for STFT; rectangular for RMS
envelope_method.normalization: each channel divided by its own 99.5th percentile and clipped to [0,1]

alignment_fit.recommended_mapping: source_time approximately equals reference_time plus recommended_constant_offset_seconds; do not time-stretch from this fit
alignment_fit.interpretation: the fitted change across the song is below one 60 Hz analysis frame; it is not sufficient evidence of a genuine tempo change
alignment_fit.subgrid_precision_note: parabolic interpolation is an estimate from 60 Hz envelopes, not sample-level or phoneme verification

energy_thresholds.method: 20 ms RMS windows with approximately 5 ms hops on decoded mono PCM; conservative tail starts at the end of the last above-threshold window
energy_thresholds.warning: below-threshold and quantized zero are not claims of mathematical silence

reference_grid_transfer.basis: reference tempo and phase transferred using high multiband-envelope correlations across the track; not an independent beat transcription
reference_grid_transfer.warning: file-duration difference is not the content alignment offset

mixed_transient_method.method: positive difference of summed log1p band magnitudes, locally normalized at 99.5th percentile
mixed_transient_method.caution: not harmonic/percussive separation; instruments and voice overlap; peaks are not verified word boundaries
